obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be certified using two certification tests
obligations.ears: The impactor shall be certified using two certification tests as follows.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: the certification shall be conducted according to the inverse certification (IC) test procedure prescribed in paragraph 1.4. of this annex before starting a vehicle test series
obligations.ears: Before starting a vehicle test series, the certification of the impactor shall be conducted according to the inverse certification (IC) test procedure prescribed in paragraph 1.4. of this annex.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: Ongoing certification testing then shall constitute the sequence IC - PC - PC - IC - PC - PC - etc. with a maximum of 10 tests between each certification
obligations.ears: The ongoing certification testing of the impactor shall constitute the sequence IC - PC - PC - IC - PC - PC - etc. with a maximum of 10 tests between each certification.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be certified according to the procedures prescribed in paragraph 1.2. below at least once a year
obligations.ears: The impactor shall be certified according to the procedures prescribed in paragraph 1.2. below at least once a year.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall meet the requirements specified in paragraph 1.2.2. of this annex
obligations.ears: When tested according to paragraph 1.2.4. of this annex, the femur and the tibia of the flexible lower legform impactor shall meet the requirements specified in paragraph 1.2.2. of this annex.

derived.text: When tested according to paragraph 1.2.4. of this annex, the femur of the flexible lower legform impactor shall meet the requirements specified in paragraph 1.2.2. of this annex.
When tested according to paragraph 1.2.4. of this annex, the tibia of the flexible lower legform impactor shall meet the requirements specified in paragraph 1.2.2. of this annex.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall meet the requirements specified in paragraph 1.2.3. of this annex
obligations.ears: When tested according to paragraph 1.2.5 of this annex, the knee joint of the lower legform impactor shall meet the requirements specified in paragraph 1.2.3. of this annex.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be 20 °C ± 2 °C
obligations.ears: During the certification tests, the stabilized temperature of the impactor shall be 20 °C ± 2 °C.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be 30 mm for the knee ligament elongations and 4 kN for the applied external load
obligations.ears: The CAC response values, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 30 mm for the knee ligament elongations and 4 kN for the applied external load.

derived.text: The CAC response value, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 30 mm for the knee ligament elongations.
The CAC response value, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 4 kN for the applied external load.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: the applied moment and the generated deflection at the centre of the femur and the tibia (Mc and Dc) shall be within the corridors shown in Figure 1
obligations.ears: When the femur and the tibia of the impactor are loaded in bending in accordance with paragraph 1.2.4. below, the applied moment and the generated deflection at the centre of the femur and the tibia (Mc and Dc) shall be within the corridors shown in Figure 1.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: the MCL, ACL, and PCL elongations and applied bending moment or the force at the centre of the knee joint (Mc or Fc) shall be within the corridors shown in Figure 2
obligations.ears: When the knee joint of the impactor is loaded in bending in accordance with paragraph 1.2.5. of this annex, the MCL, ACL, and PCL elongations and applied bending moment or the force at the centre of the knee joint (Mc or Fc) shall be within the corridors shown in Figure 2.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be mounted to the support rig firmly as shown in Figure 3 and Figure 4
obligations.ears: The edges of the femur and tibia, not bending parts, shall be mounted to the support rig firmly as shown in Figure 3 and Figure 4.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be parallel to the loading axis within 180° ± 2° tolerance
obligations.ears: The Y-axis of the impactor shall be parallel to the loading axis within 180° ± 2° tolerance.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be applied at the centre of the femur and the tibia within ±2 mm tolerance along the Z-axis
obligations.ears: The centre of the loading force shall be applied at the centre of the femur and the tibia within ±2 mm tolerance along the Z-axis.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be increased so as to maintain a deflection rate between 10 and 100 mm/minute until the bending moment at the centre part (Mc) of the femur or tibia reaches 380 Nm
obligations.ears: The force shall be increased so as to maintain a deflection rate between 10 and 100 mm/minute until the bending moment at the centre part (Mc) of the femur or tibia reaches 380 Nm.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall be mounted to the support rig firmly as shown in Figure 5
obligations.ears: The ends of the knee joint shall be mounted to the support rig firmly as shown in Figure 5.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be parallel to the loading axis within ±2° tolerance
obligations.ears: The Y-axis of the impactor shall be parallel to the loading axis within ±2° tolerance.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: a neoprene sheet shall be set underneath the loading ram and the impactor face of the knee joint which is described in the Figure 3 of Annex 4 shall be removed
obligations.ears: To avoid impactor damage, a neoprene sheet shall be set underneath the loading ram and the impactor face of the knee joint which is described in the Figure 3 of Annex 4 shall be removed.

derived.text: To avoid impactor damage, a neoprene sheet shall be set underneath the loading ram.
To avoid impactor damage, the impactor face of the knee joint which is described in the Figure 3 of Annex 4 shall be removed.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: shall have compression characteristics as shown in Figure 2
obligations.ears: The neoprene sheet used in this test shall have compression characteristics as shown in Figure 2.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall be applied at the knee joint center within ±2 mm tolerance along the Z-axis
obligations.ears: The centre of the loading force shall be applied at the knee joint center within ±2 mm tolerance along the Z-axis (see Figure 5 below).

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall be increased so as to maintain a deflection rate between 10 and 100 mm/minute until the bending moment at the centre part of the knee joint (Mc) reaches 400 Nm
obligations.ears: The external load shall be increased so as to maintain a deflection rate between 10 and 100 mm/minute until the bending moment at the centre part of the knee joint (Mc) reaches 400 Nm.
